method: Exact production state/questions entered through the existing Chrome playground UI; raw responses copied using its Copy control. No Python provider calls or SDK calls. Synthetic kitchen only.
deduplication: Full request and raw response (including evaluation_time_ms) hashed together. Copied replay prefixes count once. Distinct pairs are evidence records, not a production accuracy or network latency estimate.
limits: Small exploratory corpus. current_* examples informed tuning. holdout_final_* were run after the final prompt freeze, once each to the first complete/clarification/rejection outcome, without answers supplied. Earlier trials retain earlier prompts. Browser UI selected jev-latest; every raw model response was jev-1.14.0.

observed_outcome.question: What should happen next in this command?

options.assemble_dish: Produce one exact live ticket using only allocated bases, component instances and equipment; mixing/cooking follow its native recipe. No chopping, dispenser replacements, plate washing, serving, automatic next order, gap transport or optional/unknown recipe branches. Allocation binds exact objects; bases are alternatives. Clean stacks pin their current top plate. Missing resources wait; they never permit substitution.
options.prepare_near_player: Prepare each requested ingredient/utensil quantity and deliver it near another eligible local player. Raw preserves the exact root; processed states follow its native work chain. Empty applies to utensils/plates. A state name alone does not prove a cooking/mixing recipe or compatible equipment. No concurrent high-level jobs.
options.take_ready: Wait for food on accessible cooking equipment, remove it when ready, then serve or park using native checks.
options.wash_dishes: Collect an obtainable dirty batch where needed and wash at an accessible sink. One repetition is a batch, not one plate.
options.deliver_dirty_dishes: Collect a dirty batch and hand it off for the human to wash. Incomplete route coverage cannot prove the human-only sink condition.
options.put_out_fire: Use an obtainable extinguisher to extinguish observed fires from certified spray stances. One repetition is a reachable-fire sweep, not one flame. A selected blocked fire waits.
options.toss_burnt_food: Dispose of one ruined food/container and return a surviving empty utensil to a compatible location.
options.monitor_equipment: Watch accessible unattended cooking/mixing equipment and rescue ready output. Finite count measures rescued outputs, not seconds or polling cycles. Unlimited is a standing assignment. Chopping boards excluded.
options.deliver_completed_dishes: Deliver matching ready plated dishes, choosing the most urgent live ticket. Does not assemble or prepare missing components.
options.native_action: One explicit low-level action on an identified object or target: navigate to, pick up, place, throw, work, activate, or move an exact item. Ingredient preparation/delivery to a player belongs to prepare_near_player.
options.done: All requested occurrences have already been represented.
